lines.title: Open 8k — 3 Des
lines.useCase: Open board finish with Goyo + Brio + Des + Swap
lines.summary: 3 Des Frog line that converts into Goyo + Brio and a final Swap finish.
lines.materials: 3 Des Frog, 1 Substitoad, 1 Treeborn, 1 Fishborg, 1 Dandylion
steps: Use Substitoad to set up the Frog engine.
Fishborg loop into Dandylion and generate the Des Frog setup.
Summon first Des Frog and achieve the material shell.
Synchro into Goyo Guardian with Fishborg + Des.
Use Brionac as the second body and finish with Swap Frog to create the final board.
endBoard: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier

lines.title: Open 8k — 2 Des
lines.useCase: Open board finish with Goyo + Brio + Des + Swap
lines.summary: 2 Des Frog line using Moray / Avarice / Salvage to rebuild and finish the turn.
lines.materials: 2 Des Frog, 1 Substitoad, 1 Treeborn, Fishborg loop, Moray / Avarice / Salvage support
steps: Build the Frog engine with Substitoad and Treeborn.
Use Moray / Avarice / Salvage as recovery pieces to return to the combo.
Summon Goyo Guardian with Fishborg + Des.
Use Brionac as the second big body and keep the final Swap Frog conversion alive.
Finish with the remaining Des Frog and Swap Frog to end the turn.
endBoard: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
